title: Implement sparse FieldMatrix (CSR/CSC) over FiniteField
description:
Generic sparse matrix analogous to `SpBitMatrix`/`SpBitMatrixDual` but over arbitrary finite fields. Matches `BitMatrix`'s sparse-conversion API (`to_sparse` / `to_dense`) for naming consistency.

## Formats

- **CSR** (Compressed Sparse Row): efficient row access and SpMV
- **CSC** (Compressed Sparse Column): efficient column access
- Conversion `FieldMatrix<F>::to_sparse()` ↔ `SparseFieldMatrix<F>::to_dense()`

## Operations

```rust
pub struct SparseFieldMatrix<F: FiniteField> { /* CSR by default */ }

impl<F: FiniteField> SparseFieldMatrix<F> {
    pub fn from_triplets(rows: usize, cols: usize, triplets: impl IntoIterator<Item = (usize, usize, F)>) -> Self;
    pub fn from_dense(dense: &FieldMatrix<F>) -> Self;
    pub fn to_dense(&self) -> FieldMatrix<F>;
    pub fn to_csc(&self) -> SparseFieldMatrixCsc<F>;

    pub fn rows(&self) -> usize;
    pub fn cols(&self) -> usize;
    pub fn nnz(&self) -> usize;
    pub fn get(&self, r: usize, c: usize) -> F;

    pub fn matvec(&self, x: &FieldVec<F>) -> FieldVec<F>;                         // SpMV
    pub fn matvec_transpose(&self, x: &FieldVec<F>) -> FieldVec<F>;               // Sparse·xᵀ
    pub fn matmat(&self, rhs: &FieldMatrix<F>) -> FieldMatrix<F>;                 // SpMM: sparse × dense
}
```

`MatrixLike<F>` implemented for both sparse variants.

## Naming consistency with `BitMatrix`

- Construction, shape, access method names (`rows`, `cols`, `nnz`, `get`) mirror `SpBitMatrix`.
- `matvec` / `matvec_transpose` match the `BitMatrix` names (same operations, same contracts).

## Success criteria

- [hard] CSR and CSC representations correct; round-trip `from_dense → to_dense` preserves the matrix.
- [hard] SpMV, SpMV-transpose, SpMM correct across GF(7), GF(65521), GF(2^31-1), GF(2^8); verified against `FieldMatrix::matvec` on the dense equivalent.
- [hard] Edge cases: empty sparse matrix, all-zero matrix (nnz = 0), single-nonzero, diagonal-only, dense-as-sparse.
- [hard] Criterion micro-benchmarks for SpMV at sparsity 1%, 5% and n = 256, 1024, 4096 on GF(2^31-1) and GF(2^8).
- [hard] `MatrixLike<F>` implemented for both `SparseFieldMatrix<F>` (CSR) and `SparseFieldMatrixCsc<F>`.
- [hard] Naming parity verified against `SpBitMatrix` by PR reviewer.
- [hard] Module-level docs cite Dumas–Pernet §5 for pointers to sparse reordering (out of scope, but referenced for future reader).
